summary: Iteration 48 (v0.9.0-beta consolidation, frontend only, web preview at 390x844). All requested retests PASS. (1) HIGH source-chip fix: at Röm 8,28 the chips were switched off one at a time (calvin-de, kroeker, rieger, ansorg, streitenberger). Card counts went 2, 2, 1, 1, then 0, and the last step shows commentary-empty with every chip off. The empty state persists after reload. Turning Rieger back on shows only Rieger (stored ['rieger']), which persists after reload. Turning Calvin on gives 2 cards; re-enabling all gives 3 cards, and 'none' is stripped. (2) Scope label: 'Römer 8,28–39 (Versbereich) – keine Einzelerklärung zu V. 28' for Rieger. Ps 1,1 Kroeker and Rieger show '1,1–6 (Versbereich)'. The data check reports 0 'range labelled Einzelvers' entries (iteration 47 had 1,611). (3) Ansorg: 1Mo 1,5, 1,20, 1,1 and 1,31 all show ansorg-1-1-1 '1,1–31 (Versbereich)'. Neh 1,5 shows Ansorg 1,1–11. The Stelle mismatches fell from 475 to 9; all 9 are ranges that cross chapters (LOW). (4) Regression after removing dependencies: intro, welcome, the 4 tabs, /station/tora-1-1, /lexicon, /lexicon/abraham, /timeline, /settings, /media, /living/words, /world/tora, /study/sources, /synopsis and /way all render. There were 0 pageerrors, 0 console errors and no module-not-found errors; the expo error log is clean. No source imports of the removed packages remain. expo-symbols is still in yarn.lock only as a transitive dependency of expo-router, which is expected. (5) Node tests 42/42 pass; tsc --noEmit exit 0.

integration_issues.flow: Ansorg verse mapping – ranges that cross chapters
integration_issues.issue: 9 of 705 Ansorg sermons are still mapped to their first verse only (scope 'verse') because their Stelle range crosses a chapter boundary: ansorg-12-2-19 (2Kön 2:19-6:7), ansorg-16-7-1 (Neh 7:1-13:31), ansorg-20-8-1 (Spr 8:1-9:18), ansorg-27-10-1 (Dan 10:1-12:13), ansorg-30-1-1 (Am 1:1-2:7), ansorg-40-2-13 (Mt 2:13-4:2), ansorg-40-9-35 (Mt 9:35-10:10), ansorg-40-27-57 (Mt 27:57-28:20). ansorg-27-4-1 has 'Daniel 4:1-4:37', which stays within one chapter but uses the c:v-c:v format, so it is still mapped to 4,1 only. LOW.

action_items: LOW: Ansorg importer. Parse the 'c:v-c:v' format. At minimum handle the same-chapter case Dan 4:1-4:37 (ansorg-27-4-1). Optionally split the 8 sermons that cross chapters into one range entry per chapter.

LOW (optional): When re-enabling every source chip, normalise prefSources to [] instead of the explicit list of all 5 ids. With the explicit list, a source added in a future release would be hidden by default for users who once toggled the chips.
critical_code_review_comments: VerseStudy.tsx:80: the source-chip off-branch now maps an empty rest to ['none'], and the on-branch strips 'none'. Correct. The on-branch does not collapse a full list back to [], unlike the tradition handler at line 70, so the state stays un-normalised (see the action item).
Persistence of prefSources is debounced. localStorage still held the previous value immediately after the tap, but the value was correct after reload, so this is not a bug.
